title: Nettie/Transcript
html:
This is a transcript of conversations with Nettie.

Introduction

Nettie: Give me a moment. I'll be right with you.

  • Player: Is there anything I can do to help?
    • Nettie: A moment!
Vis medicatrix...
There. It's up to her now. Life or death.
    • (If the player is a Drow or Duergar and has not exposed Kagha)
      • Nettie: Now, what -
        • Nettie: Drow. Last time I saw one of you folk, he tried to slit me open. I hope you're more agreeable.
        • Player: Where did you see another drow?
          • Nettie: That's neither here nor there.
Look, you obviously want something. What is it?
        • Player: Enough. I need your abilities.
          • Nettie: Just be glad my bedside manner's better than yours.
Come here. Let's have a look at you.
        • Player: That depends. How good of a healer are you?
        • Nettie: A grey dwarf. Never thought I'd meet a decent one, but I heard what you did at the gates.
    • (If the player is a Drow or Duergar and has exposed Kagha)
      • Nettie: So. A grey dwarf. Never thought I'd meet a decent one, but I heard what you did out there.
      • Nettie: So. The last time I saw a drow, he tried to slit me open. I hope you're more agreeable.
    • (Otherwise)
      • Now, what was it you needed?
  • Player: Wait patiently.
  • Player: Excuse me? I'm more important than some bird.
  • > Leave.

Speak with Dead

If Nettie dies, the player can cast  Speak with Dead on her body. The player can then ask up to five questions.

Player: How do I get out of this room? (If Nettie has locked you in the Enclave Library at the time.)

  • Nettie: My circlet...

Player: Who are you? (If you skipped Nettie's introduction scene.)

    • Nettie: Nettie... apprentice healer... to Master Halsin...

Player: What happened to you?

  • (If Nettie was killed after poisoning the player, or trying to.)
    • Nettie: Wanted to protect... wanted to give... mercy...
  • (Otherwise)
    • Nettie: Tried to protect... our grove...

Player: Where did you keep your valuables?

  • Nettie: Beneath... locked by runes...
    • Player: And how do I get past these locks?
      • Nettie: Wolf Rune... Rath...

Player: Where is Halsin?

  • Nettie: Gone... with adventurers...
Nettie: Went to goblins... never came back...

Player: How can I get rid of the mind flayer parasite?

  • Nettie: Find Halsin... knows parasites... studied them...
  • Nettie: Master Halsin... studied parasites... hunted the source...
Absolute... Moonrise Towers...

Player: Halsin's dead. Is there any other way to get rid of a mind flayer parasite?

  • Nettie: Master Halsin... studied parasites... hunted the source...
Absolute... Moonrise Towers...

Player: Halsin's dead. I thought you'd want to know.

  • Narrator: *The corpse says nothing. Its dead eyes convey no pain, only acceptance.*
